title: Geometric Attractor Monitoring: A Robust and Frugal Framework for Multi-modal Industrial Robotic Cycles
abstract: arXiv:2608.30804v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Monitoring the health of heterogeneous industrial robot fleets is severely challenged by the multi-modal nature of their operational cycles and a persistent scarcity of run-to-failure data. Standard data-driven approaches, particularly deep learning architectures relying on sequential reconstruction, often struggle in this specific setting; they tend to over-smooth complex dynamics, masking early signs of degradation. To address these industrial constraints, we reframe the monitoring problem through a framework based on Phase Space Reconstruction (PSR). Instead of predicting temporal sequences, this framework transforms univariate sensor data into a geometric attractor, explicitly unfolding the mechanical states independently of their temporal occurrence. translated_title: 几何吸引子监测：一种面向多模态工业机器人周期的鲁棒且轻量的框架
translated_abstract: 监测异构工业机器人机群的健康状况，严重受制于其运行周期的多模态特性以及运行至失效数据的持续稀缺。标准的数据驱动方法，特别是依赖序列重构的深度学习架构，在这种特定场景下往往表现不佳；它们倾向于对复杂的动力学进行过度平滑，从而掩盖早期退化迹象。为应对这些工业约束，我们通过基于相空间重构（PSR）的框架重新构建监测问题。该框架不再预测时间序列，而是将单变量传感器数据转换为几何吸引子，显式地展开机械状态，且独立于其时间发生顺序。通过在该空间中评估多种异常评分技术，我们证明了离散支持度估计能够提供一种有效且计算上轻量的健康指标（HI）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于相空间重构的几何吸引子监测框架，将单变量传感器数据转换为几何吸引子并结合离散支持度估计，为多模态工业机器人周期提供了一种鲁棒且计算轻量的健康指标，摆脱了对运行至失效数据和时序深度学习模型的依赖。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a Phase Space Reconstruction-based geometric attractor monitoring framework that transforms univariate sensor data into geometric attractors combined with discrete support estimation, delivering a robust and computationally frugal health indicator for multi-modal industrial robotic cycles without relying on run-to-failure data or sequential deep learning models.
